description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Personal information and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PreTravelInformation" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails" name="Booking details" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Start_BookingReceived" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket" name="Ticket" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PreTravelInformation" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendPreTravelInformation" targetRef="Start_PreTravelInformation" messageRef="Message_PreTravelInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket booking and journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Ticket search begins"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravel" name="Post-travel feedback or services?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Journey" name="Journey completed"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PostTravel" name="Provide feedback or use post-travel services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PostTravel" name="Post-travel follow-up completed"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PreTravelInformation" name="Receive pre-travel reminders and instructions" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PreTravelInformation" name="Pre-travel reminders or instructions received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PreTravelInformation" messageRef="Message_PreTravelInformation"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PreTravelInformation" name="Pre-travel information received"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreTravelInformation" sourceRef="Start_PreTravelInformation" targetRef="End_PreTravelInformation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_Yes" name="Feedback or services" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="Task_PostTravel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">postTravelFeedbackOrServices</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_No" name="No follow-up" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="End_Journey"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_End" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="End_PostTravel"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company ticket processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BookingReceived" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingDetails" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket by email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PreTravelInformation" name="Send pre-travel reminders or instructions?" default="Flow_NoPreTravelInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPreTravelInformation" name="Send pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Message_PreTravelInformation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TravelCompany" name="Ticket processing completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="Start_BookingReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_PreTravelInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendPreTravelInformation" name="Reminders or instructions to send" sourceRef="Gateway_PreTravelInformation" targetRef="Task_SendPreTravelInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">preTravelInformationToSend</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPreTravelInformation" name="No reminders or instructions" sourceRef="Gateway_PreTravelInformation" targetRef="End_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" sourceRef="Task_SendPreTravelInformation" targetRef="End_TravelCompany"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
